How it started.

The Heat led 34–30 after one quarter. At the half, the Heat led 68–59.

2 of 5 · The difference

Giannis: 29 points and 14 rebounds

14 of 23 from the floor, with 2 steals and 2 blocks.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the second quarter 34–29

Up 4 after one quarter, the Heat won the second quarter 34–29 to lead 68–59. Giannis and Klay combined for 52 of 114.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it from three: 18 makes to 11

Threes made 18–11; assists 29–24. Miami made just 8 of 18 free throws.

5 of 5 · Final

Heat 114, Kings 108.

From the Kings’ side: Lost the second quarter 29–34, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: Heat 5–6, 7th in the East, 31% top-6 odds. Kings 1–10, 14th in the West, 0%.
